metaDescription: Order custom poly propylene sunscreen in bulk. Ideal for outdoor events and safety kits. Get your brand on sunscreen today.
introHtml: Poly propylene sunscreen tubes offer a lightweight, durable option for outdoor events, construction sites, and company safety kits. Unlike glass or standard plastic, poly propylene resists cracking and holds up in hot vehicles, making it a practical choice for field teams and giveaways. These tubes accept screen printing or labels cleanly, so your logo stands out on a functional item that gets used repeatedly.
heroAltText: Custom poly propylene sunscreen tubes with brand logo, ideal for outdoor events and safety kits
